data.body:
[P2] Validate identity before replay hooks fire

Standard operations enter `DurableContext._replay_aware()` before this lookup, and that context manager emits replay/update plugin hooks immediately. A mismatched checkpoint therefore dispatches a stale `on_operation_start`, or `on_operation_end` for an externally updated terminal operation, before this validation raises. OTel and custom plugins can publish incorrect lifecycle telemetry for an execution rejected as nondeterministic. Validate the peeked checkpoint before emitting either hook, or defer hook dispatch until after this validated lookup, and add plugin regression coverage.
